description: Task-fit regression expectations, not ground-truth model superiority. Frozen before live evaluation. No task asks to select its expected model. Three trials reorder candidates. Priority and constraints are part of the task contract.

codex.prompt: Return only BUG or FEATURE for this title: add CSV export. This is interactive autocomplete; minimal response latency matters.
Run the known command npm test -- --runInBand and summarize its exit code. The command is already approved; no design work is needed.

Implement appointment rescheduling across the existing API handler, database transaction and UI form. Preserve permissions and validation, add integration coverage, and keep changes compatible with the established architecture. This is a defined feature, not a new architecture.

Extend an existing plugin system to validate configuration in the CLI, propagate typed errors through two modules, and preserve compatibility for current plugins. Implement and verify the coordinated changes; the public behavior is specified.

Choose a consistency strategy for a payments migration across independently failing regions. Analyze irreversible side effects, idempotency, reconciliation and recovery when acknowledgments are lost. No agreed architecture exists; correctness dominates latency.

Two implemented fixes still allow duplicate settlements under interleaved retries across three services. Establish the root cause and invariants from conflicting traces before proposing another patch. The cause remains unknown.

Urgent: diagnose a three-service consistency failure after two incorrect fixes. Speed matters, but do not trade away the reasoning needed to establish the cross-system invariant and prevent another incorrect patch.

claude.prompt: Extract the order ID from this sentence and return only it: order ORD-318 arrived. This runs in a live UI; latency is the main concern.
Implement pagination in the existing React component using the current endpoint and add boundary tests. I need a responsive coding agent, but it must inspect and modify the repository correctly.

Implement a specified enterprise role-management workflow across API authorization, database persistence and three UI screens, with backward-compatible migrations and integration tests. Requirements are settled; carry the implementation through reliably.

Refactor a mature plugin engine across seven modules without changing public behavior. Preserve lifecycle ordering, typing and extension compatibility, and verify the cross-module regression tests. The desired design is already agreed.

Develop and validate a new architecture for a multi-region workflow engine over a long autonomous task. Resolve conflicting guarantees, failure recovery and novel cross-system invariants. Prioritize deepest reasoning and final correctness over latency and cost.
The previous high-effort Opus implementation failed adversarial concurrency tests twice. Reconsider the causal model and derive a correct invariant before changing the distributed workflow again.

Urgent recovery diagnosis: the previous high-effort Opus fixes failed twice and the distributed invariant remains unresolved. Need the fastest response that still supplies the missing deeper reasoning; another shallow patch is unacceptable.
